expectations.buyer: EV fleet owners, battery dismantlers, second-life integrators, recyclers, insurers, and storage project developers
expectations.pain: Used traction batteries need safe qualification, state-of-health evidence, liability allocation, logistics, and bankable valuation before reuse or recycling
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM battery management data, EU battery-passport infrastructure, certified testing and logistics providers, recyclers, repurposers, and existing battery marketplaces
expectations.biggestRisk: Passport data may not prove remaining useful life or safety, OEM access and physical testing may dominate, and marketplace liquidity/liability may be weak
